projects.title: Injection-Molding Cell Troubleshooting
projects.summary: Production support across PLC, vision, robot, sensor and pneumatic layers.
projects.challenge: Isolate faults across interconnected PLC, HMI, vision, robot, sensor and pneumatic systems during production support.
projects.description: Troubleshoot PLC-controlled injection-molding cells and downstream equipment at Axiom Group. The work follows the complete signal path—from field device and I/O through logic, HMI, robot motion and final machine response.
projects.outcome: Supported reliable production recovery, commissioning, I/O verification and controlled sequence changes in live manufacturing environments.
points: Diagnose PLC, HMI, robot, vision, sensor and communication faults.
Modify machine sequences and HMI parameters after systematic verification.
Teach robot positions and support EOAT, pneumatic gripper and vacuum changes.
Complete I/O checks, functional testing and production trials.

projects.title: Multi-Camera Vision Inspection Upgrade
projects.summary: A complete PLC and machine-vision workflow update from logic review to validation.
projects.challenge: Keep the PLC sequence, camera inspection programs and result mapping consistent through a complete vision-system upgrade.
projects.description: Upgraded a multi-camera inspection system by reviewing the existing PLC sequence, creating new vision programs, updating inspection-result mapping and testing the complete workflow.
projects.outcome: Completed and validated the end-to-end PLC/vision upgrade with clear result handling and reject logic.
points: Analyzed existing PLC logic, sequence conditions and interlocks.
Created and configured new machine-vision inspection programs.
Updated camera-result mapping between the vision system and PLC.
Performed end-to-end testing and troubleshooting before release.

projects.title: Automation Backup Manager
projects.summary: A verifiable workflow for PLC, HMI, robot, fixture and vision-system backups.
projects.challenge: Organize scattered automation backups into a traceable workflow while preserving original source files.
projects.description: Defined and built a desktop tool that standardizes backup naming, folder creation, history and monthly coverage. It creates SHA-256-verified ZIP packages while preserving the original source.
projects.outcome: Turns scattered automation files into an organized, searchable and auditable maintenance workflow.
points: Guided package creation with consistent cell, equipment and date naming.
Monthly status makes missing backups visible at a glance.
Search and audit history speed up recovery of known versions.
Storage views show retained versions by equipment and month.

experience.detail: Troubleshoot PLC-controlled injection-molding cells; modify Omron PLC logic, HMI parameters and machine sequences; work with Keyence IV2/IV3 vision, Wittmann robot positions and EOAT; support commissioning, I/O verification and production trials.
highlights: Troubleshoot PLC-controlled injection-molding cells and downstream equipment across electrical, mechanical, pneumatic, hydraulic and controls systems.
Modify Omron PLC logic, HMI parameters, machine sequences, vision settings and sensor configurations after systematic verification.
Support Keyence IV2/IV3 vision systems, Wittmann robot position teaching, EOAT changes, label printers and industrial communications.
Perform root-cause analysis, I/O checks and corrective actions to restore production and prevent recurring automation faults.
Commission automation improvements and validate safety conditions, machine sequences and first-pass readiness through production trials.

experience.detail: Developed PLC programs and HMI screens; integrated PLCs, robots, vision, servo drives, VFDs and networks; supported startup, testing and customer acceptance.
highlights: Developed and commissioned PLC software using Siemens S7-1200, Allen-Bradley Studio 5000 and Omron platforms.
Designed HMI applications for diagnostics, alarms and machine operation, improving operator visibility during production and service.
Integrated PLCs with robots, vision systems, servo drives, VFDs and industrial networks across complete automation projects.
Executed startup, debugging, I/O verification, functional testing and customer acceptance for automated equipment.
Prepared technical documentation and refined control sequences to improve maintainability and commissioning efficiency.

experience.detail: Provided technical service and troubleshooting of PLC machinery using diagnostics, schematics, multimeters and oscilloscopes; supported breakdowns, maintenance, commissioning and I/O checks.
highlights: Troubleshot PLC-controlled industrial machinery and electrical control panels, restoring equipment during breakdowns and service calls.
Used PLC diagnostics, electrical drawings, multimeters and oscilloscopes to isolate electrical, controls and communication faults.
Performed preventive and corrective maintenance and supported customers during urgent equipment failures.
Supported installation, commissioning and testing by verifying I/O signals, sensors, actuators, interlocks and machine sequences.

experience.detail: Built and wired control panels per schematics, including PLC hardware, relays, terminals and power supplies; completed wiring verification, electrical checks and functional testing.
highlights: Built and wired industrial control panels from electrical schematics, including PLC hardware, relays, terminals and power supplies.
Installed and labeled industrial control devices and completed point-to-point wiring verification.
Performed electrical checks and functional testing before panels were released for machine integration and commissioning.
